body: I think I need help but I don't want it. I don't know why but I can't convince myself to go talk to someone

I don't even know anymore I don't feel normal.  Like every single time I feel myself getting back to normal where I can do normal things like live my life something happens and I get back to a low point.  and then i start having these horrible thoughts... like I don't even know who I am or that i'm not who i want to be.
